Rheumatoid factor and antinuclear antibodies.
The humoral immune system abnormalities observed in silicosis include an increased incidence and titer of rheumatoid factor, antinuclear antibodies, and immune complexes.
Rheumatoid factor, antinuclear antibodies, and non-organ specific antibodies may be present in the blood.
Antinuclear antibodies screening due to association with autoimmune diseases such as SLE.
